title: NekoScan PCs
description: Snapshots of nearby PlayerCharacter objects from the NekoScan v2 plugin.

ContentId.description: The character's permanent, unique in-game identifier Content ID.

Name.description: The character's current display name. Legacy 1.0 characters can have up to two 15-letter names.

HomeWorldId.description: The World ID of the character's Home World.

CurrentWorldId.description: The World ID where the character was seen - may differ from HomeWorldId (e.g. World Visit).

TerritoryId.description: The TerritoryType ID of the zone the character was last seen in.

JobId.description: The ClassJob ID of the character's current class/job.

Level.description: The character's current level for JobId.

FCTag.description: The character's Free Company tag, without the surrounding « » guillemets. Empty string when none or unknown.

Gender.description: Read from the native customize data's Sex byte: 0 maps to "M", anything else to "F".

TimeSeenUtc.description: UTC instant this character was observed, ISO 8601 with offset - e.g. "2026-08-31T12:00:00.123Z".

TitleId.description: The Title ID of the character's equipped title. 0 means no title.
